confirmed_not_saved.condition: Known connectivity problem prevented a save request, or an authoritative result confirms that no save was applied. Never use this example for a possible but unconfirmed write.
confirmed_not_saved.marker: Normal white outline heart, no circular face,22px inside existing44px target.
confirmed_not_saved.feedback: บันทึกบ้านไม่ได้ / การเชื่อมต่อขัดข้อง, only when that cause is known.
confirmed_not_saved.action: ลองอีกครั้ง: user initiates a save request only when safe; no automatic retry loop.

unknown_result.condition: Connection lost after a save may have reached the system. Neither saved nor unsaved is established.
unknown_result.marker: Temporary white question marker inside existing44px target; new save/toggle inactive.
unknown_result.feedback: ยังไม่ทราบผลบันทึก / การเชื่อมต่อขาดหาย.
unknown_result.action: ตรวจสอบ: status read/reconciliation only, not another save. If confirmed saved, use accepted saved-r28; if confirmed not saved, offer explicit retry; if unresolved, retain unknown.

proposed_behavior.origin: Home position, selected villa/rail/photo and authenticated state remain under the active-flow contract; no extra Login solely for save connection failure.
proposed_behavior.other_causes: Do not describe all save failures as connectivity. Unavailable villa, changed auth/session and other causes need their own verified handling; not all are designed or accepted here.
proposed_behavior.boundary: Local cropped-card proposals only; no actual API/reconciliation/session/lifetime/whole-page toast policy implemented or selected.
